protocol.initial_history_variance: s^2 at start of trailing730-return window
protocol.posterior_coordinates: u=mu/s, y=log(s); prior includes Jacobian exp(y)
protocol.quadrature: tensor trapezoid;65^2 coarse; marginal1e-8 tails+4coarse-cell padding;local65,129,257 meshes
protocol.edge_strip: outer2% of each coordinate interval; numerical proxy, not excluded-tail bound
protocol.entry: first innovation is next-day entry; then requested integer holding days
protocol.parameter_uncertainty: one joint(mu,s,h_next) draw per path, held across all days/horizons
protocol.failure: FitError; no plug-in or pooled fallback
protocol.interpretation: price-only model-based reconstruction, not calibrated or production-qualified

design.generator:
rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
h = scale**2
returns = np.empty(730)
for t in range(730):
    shock = np.sqrt(h) * np.sqrt(3/5) * rng.standard_t(5)
    returns[t] = drift + shock
    h = .01*scale**2 + .05*shock**2 + .94*h
design.scope: numerical quadrature preflight only; no posterior calibration, market data, model selection or tuning
